plain_text:
Alan Ladd appears in 64 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1939 to 1951. The credits here include performer and commercial spokesman.

In this archive, you will hear Alan Ladd most often in Box 13, Lux Radio Theatre, Screen Directors Playhouse, and Duffy's Tavern.

Characters credited here include Dan Holiday.
